prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic extreme close-up portrait of a clearly adult woman in a chaotic backstage dressing alcove, using a synthetic-tradition cyberpunk geisha aesthetic. Apply physically textured crimson geometric paint to the skin and tactile raised plastic smiley-face decals on the cheeks. A textured red glitter-mesh fingerless glove rests gently against the cheekbone, creating realistic but comfortable skin contact. Give the adult subject a neutral intense expression, piercing unblinking gaze, natural pores, structured dark bangs, and subtle tassel elements. Dress her in a kimono-inspired blue-and-red silk brocade collar with a red silk tassel headpiece. Use deep magenta gel key light, cyan rim light, and blurred warm tungsten vanity bulbs; capture glove fibers, decal texture, paint, eyes, and skin with a Hasselblad H6D-100c-style camera and 120mm macro lens. Use a Cinestill 800T-inspired look with visible fine grain, raw analog fidelity, natural lip sheen, and no harm or force.
